items.title: Joseph's brothers
items.charge: Conspiracy to murder; selling a brother; deceiving their father with a bloodied coat

items.title: Judah and Tamar
items.charge: Withholding Shelah from his brother's widow; going in to a woman he took for a harlot

items.title: Nineveh under Jonah
items.charge: Wickedness come up before the Lord

items.title: Saul of Tarsus
items.charge: Persecuting the church; consenting to Stephen's death; compelling the saints to blaspheme

items.title: Saul's rash oath, and the people at the blood
items.charge: A rash oath that snared the army; the people eating flesh with the blood; the son who unknowingly broke the oath

items.title: The Samaritan village, and the sons of thunder
items.charge: Refusing to receive him because his face was toward Jerusalem; James and John asking for fire from heaven
